_meta.purpose: Sourcing reference for the Candidates card. Programs are durable; nurseries decay (lastVerified field tracks freshness).
_meta.freshnessConvention: Green: verified within 6 months. Amber: 6-12 months. Faded: > 12 months.

programs.name: GNPS North GA Mountains Chapter Native Plant Sale
programs.what: Annual native plant sale, late May. Stock specifically appropriate to the North Georgia Mountains region. Cash or check only.
programs.next: Saturday May 30, 2026, 8am-1pm, Union County Farmers Market, Blairsville

programs.name: Georgia Forestry Commission Annual Seedling Sale
programs.what: Native trees in landowner-scale quantities. Order opens July 1 for December-March planting season. Free pickup at any GFC office.

programs.name: UGA State Botanical Garden — Connect to Protect
programs.what: Plantapalooza (spring) and Bluestems & Bluejeans (fall) plant sales. Georgia-provenance natives. Also sells seeds; donations to schools.

programs.name: Birds Georgia × Beech Hollow Wildflower Farm Native Plant Sales
programs.what: Twice-yearly sales (typically spring + fall). Native plants for birds, butterflies, bees. Pickup in Athens or Decatur.

programs.name: Chattahoochee Nature Center Native Plant Sales
programs.what: Spring + fall native plant sales. Closer than Athens for North Georgia.

programs.name: The American Chestnut Foundation — Georgia Chapter
programs.what: Restoration Chestnut 1.0 — landowner participation in test plantings. Multi-year cohort cycle; relational rather than catalog. The two big landowner-participation restoration species in the southern Appalachians are chestnut + hemlock.

programs.name: Hemlock Restoration Initiative + GFC HWA Program
programs.what: Hemlock Woolly Adelgid treatment protocols (imidacloprid + dinotefuran soil drench) for existing hemlocks. Conservation network for resistant stock when planting. GFC HWA: https://gatrees.org/hemlock-woolly-adelgid-hwa-in-georgia/

nurseries.name: Native Forest Nursery
nurseries.specialty: Native trees and shrubs. Closest specialty native nursery to Fernwood.

nurseries.name: Beech Hollow Farms / Beech Hollow Wildflower Farm
nurseries.specialty: Wildflowers, pollinator natives. Partner for Birds Georgia spring + fall plant sales.

nurseries.name: Baker Environmental Nursery
nurseries.specialty: Native trees, shrubs, perennials. Wholesale + retail.

nurseries.name: Rock Spring Restorations
nurseries.specialty: Georgia restoration. Walter Bland's expertise on Georgia clay soils and eroded lands. Has Georgia-provenance seeds.

nurseries.name: Gardens of the Blue Ridge
nurseries.specialty: Hard-to-find Appalachian wildflowers — native azaleas, lady's slippers, trilliums. Mail-order.

nurseries.name: Atlanta Botanical Garden — Safeguarding Nursery
nurseries.specialty: Rare/at-risk species (pitcher plants, native orchids, threatened taxa). Largest safeguarding nursery in the Southeast. Relationship-based — not catalog shopping.
